specs.title: Boots to the title (normal + lowfx) with 0 console errors / unhandled rejections
specs.method: Fresh browser context per mode (`?lowfx=1&mute=1`, and `?mute=1` in full runs), real-time loop running; wait for phase `title` + 3 s; read `__qs.errors` and page console errors/pageerrors; composited screenshot must not be blank. Boot time vs the 3 s budget is reported (warn only, SwiftShader).
specs.details: lowfx: boot 7867 ms, 0 errors, 0 warnings; normal: boot 5054 ms, 0 errors, 0 warnings · lowfx: boot 7867 ms > 3 s budget (headless SwiftShader) · normal: boot 5054 ms > 3 s budget (headless SwiftShader)

specs.title: All 13 endings run to completion (script-driven) with __qs.errors empty
specs.method: Ending sweep (tests/lib/endings.mjs): each scenario on a freshly loaded page, played from `qs.start` to the ending card with `__qa.tick`; `__qs.errors` and console errors are collected per scenario (all attempts).

specs.title: 10 consecutive rounds (retry / rewrite / title) without crash; GPU memory plateaus after round 3
specs.method: One page, 10 rounds: start → retry → rewrite (real UI: preset tab + 写好了 + hold-to-crumple) → title → … Each round throws at crush / floor / trash in turn (perfect, lost, three_pointer sets) and plays to the card. At every card: `renderer.info.memory`, JS heap, errors. Memory must not grow after the last round that introduced a new set/ending (baseline ≥ round 3), tolerance max(8, 5 %).
specs.details: 10/10 rounds completed. geometries 52→62→67→71→73→71→74→76→74→76, textures 25→28→33→36→36→36→39→39→39→42 (baseline round 3). geometries keep growing: 67 at round 3 → 76 by round 10; textures keep growing: 33 at round 3 → 42 by round 10

specs.title: After any ending, 再来一局 returns to a clean aim view
specs.method: For every ending in the sweep: `cardChoice("retry")` (falls back to clicking 再来一局) → intro → aim + 0.8 s; compare with the fresh-round aim snapshot taken before the throw: phase/timeScale=1/not paused/cam fp/stage classroom/input enabled/ball held, no new full-screen DOM overlays, top/bottom band not black (letterbox), overall luminance within ±40 % (fade/flash), one render call per frame (no PiP), no HUD line of the fresh view missing (digits and names normalised; new lines such as lecture bubbles are ignored).
specs.details: 13 retries checked.

specs.title: Real input: title → gender → letter (preset + custom) → hold to crumple → intro → aim
specs.method: Natural real-time mode (rAF loop + SwiftShader rendering), Playwright clicks on visible labels (我是男生/开始/preset title/自己写/写好了), keyboard typing into the textarea, `mouse.down` held until the phase leaves `letter`, one click to skip the intro. Pass 1 uses a preset; then the round is finished (manual fast-forward) and 改写情书 is clicked for pass 2 with custom text. Checks `ctx.round.letter` = exactly what was chosen/typed and phase `aim` with `cam.mode` fp.

preset: phase aim, letter "今天的夕阳很好看。
如果能和你一起看…"; custom: phase aim, letter "放学后的走廊很长，我想和你一起走完它…". Intro skip: 1226 ms, 7094 ms.

specs.title: Real input: moving the mouse in aim changes the view within angle limits
specs.method: Fresh round at aim (teacher forced writing). Playwright `mouse.move` to centre / left / right / top / bottom edges, 1.5 s of game time each (manual stepping). Camera yaw/pitch are read from the rendered camera's world direction. Pass: left > centre > right yaw, top > bottom pitch, yaw range ≥ 40°, pitch range ≥ 20°, |yaw| ≤ 90°, pitch within [−60°, 60°].

specs.title: Real input: hold LMB charges (power rises, arm lifts) → release throws, camera follows
specs.method: Fresh aim round. `document.elementFromPoint` at the press point must be the game canvas. Real `mouse.down` → 0.7 s manual stepping: `aim.charging`, `aim.power` rising, mean camera-local Y of the meshes parented to the camera (FP arms) must rise > 1 cm. `mouse.up` → within 0.2 s ball `flying`, phase `flight`, `ball:launched`; within 0.5 s `cam.mode` = follow; launch heading within 10° of the view yaw.

specs.title: Real input: hold RMB / Space to pretend to study — suspicion drops, charging impossible
specs.method: Fresh aim round, teacher forced `watching`, suspicion 0.6. (1) real right-button hold 1.5 s: `aim.studying`, suspicion falls ≥ 0.15, camera pitch drops (looks at the book). (2) real Space hold, then real LMB press 0.6 s: no charging, power 0; release: no launch. (3) LMB charge then Space mid-charge: `aim:cancel`, release does not throw.

specs.title: Real input in flight: C cycles camera styles; Space = slow motion; A/D shift the landing point

Baseline twice (determinism), then real Space+D held from 0.15 s after launch, then Space+A, then KeyC presses. Pass: baselines identical (< 1 cm), Space → timeScale < 0.9 and `ball:willpower {on:true}`, D and A each move the landing ≥ 0.15 m and to opposite sides, each C press changes the follow style (cam:mode event with a different style or camera→ball offset change > 25°).

specs.title: Timer reaching zero → coward ending

specs.title: solveLaunch + launch lands on the target seat for ≥ 90 % of solvable seats (29 seats)
specs.method: Physics sandbox (tests swallow ball:launched/landed so the round stays in aim): quiet class (`setAmbient(false)`), teacher forced writing, wind frozen. For every non-player seat: `solveLaunch(__qs.target(seat))` → `launch` → step until landed. Hit = Landing desk/chair with that seatId. Full run: seeds 11 and 23 (different occupants); quick: seed 11, every 3rd seat. Also reports unsolvable seats and solver-prediction mismatches.

specs.title: 200 random throws: 0 NaN, 0 tunnelling, all land within 8 s
specs.method: Physics sandbox, quiet class, teacher frozen, wind frozen. Seeded random yaw ∈ [−85°, 85°], pitch ∈ [−15°, 75°], power ∈ [0, 1] via `gameplay.launch`. Every tick: finite pos/vel; centre never leaves the room except through the open window w1 (crossing point checked); never crosses a thin desk/chair/podium/book slab from above its top to below its bottom inside its footprint. `ball:landed` must arrive within 8 s of game time. A fresh round every 50 throws.

specs.title: Bounces, rolling and settling are plausible; a head hit bounces off and triggers a reaction
specs.method: Sandbox. (1) A flat throw (pitch ~20°) onto a desk with the full position log: bounce apex heights must decrease, the ball must come to rest (drift < 5 mm over 1 s after ball:landed), roll distance after first contact < 1.5 m; 6 frames from a QA side camera go to qa/shots/C3/ for review. (2) In the normal flow (reactions only run in `flight`), flat throws at the heads of the nearest classmates in front (ballistic aim at the head centre): a `ball:hit` tagged head must occur, the post-hit velocity must point away from the head, and a reaction must follow within 1.5 s (`student:event` or `ai.students.react` for that id, or an expression/clip change visible as a student:event).

Tell: during each warning the teacher character gets a clip/emote/lookAt/expression call, a bubble/say, or the head rotates ≥ 4° (visible), and an audio event appears in `ctx.audio.debug.recent` or an `audio.sfx` call (audible). specs.title: All 13 endings reachable by deterministic scripts; resolve() matches the GDD §7 table
specs.method: (1) Ending sweep: one scenario per ending (tests/lib/endings.mjs) with fixed seeds; each attempt checks the physical precondition (e.g. landed on the crush's desk, unseen) and then that `ctx.round.endingId` is the expected ending. >1 attempt needed = unstable (warn). (2) `ctx.story.resolve()` is called on 24 synthetic rounds built from the live roster (all GDD §7 rows + priority edges); strict rows must match, interpretation rows only warn.

While the ending plays, the visible DOM text is sampled every 0.1 s; the full normalised letter must appear on screen (typewriter allowed) or in a `say`/`letterReveal` text. specs.title: Gallery: unlocks persist across reloads; locked endings show hints; new unlocks show NEW
specs.method: Fresh browser context (empty localStorage). Play coward (roundSeconds 3) twice: first card must say NEW and `ending:shown.isNew` true, second must not. Reload: `story.gallery.unlocked()` and localStorage `qingshu.endings` still contain it. On the title screen click 结局图鉴 (fallback `ui.gallery()`): the unlocked title is listed and ≥ 90 % of locked endings show their `hint` text; screenshot.

specs.title: Follow cam keeps the ball in the central 70 % in ≥ 90 % of flight frames; never hidden by nearby geometry
specs.method: Every throw of the ending sweep (≈ 11 flights, different targets) is sampled each tick while phase = flight, ball flying and `cam.mode` = follow: the ball centre is projected with the render camera; in-centre = in front and |ndc x|,|y| ≤ 0.7. Every 3rd frame 5 rays (centre ± ball radius) are cast from the camera against visible opaque meshes: all 5 blocked by something < 1 m from the camera = "hidden by nearby geometry". Also flags the camera inside a static collider box. The camera module's own `cam.metrics` ratio is shown for comparison.
specs.details: 11 flights, 2234 follow frames: 100 % in the central 70 %; per flight perfect 100%, same_gender 100%, wrong_caught 100%, wrong_accept 100%, chalk_counter 100%, graded 100%, three_pointer 100%, out_window 100%, confetti 100%, self_love 100%, lost 100%. ball fully hidden by geometry < 1 m from the lens: out_window ×2 (curtains<classroom)

specs.method: Sweep flights: minimum `engine.timeScale` while the ball flies must be < 0.85. Afterwards: timeScale must be exactly 1 when the ending card is up, and 1 again in the aim phase after 再来一局.

Every new entry of `ctx.audio.debug.recent` is collected each tick; each required name must appear. Names seen only through `ctx.audio.sfx` call spies (not in debug.recent) give a warning.

specs.title: Master volume 0 = total silence; settings persist
specs.method: Unmuted page. Every connection to the AudioContext destination is routed through a QA analyser (installed before boot). Title → 设置 → the 主音量 slider is set to 0 with a real fill → sfx("ding") + sfx("bell") + title music → peak at the destination must be < 1e-4 over 0.6 s. Sanity: at 0.8 the same sounds must be audible (peak > 1e-3), otherwise the measurement is inconclusive. Reload → `ctx.settings.masterVolume` and localStorage `qingshu.settings` keep 0. Also `?mute=1` boot must be silent and must not persist: reloading the same profile without mute=1 must restore audible volume.
specs.details: start masterVolume 0.8; peak default 0.5751, master 0 0.000000, after reload 0.000000 (masterVolume 0), ?mute=1 0.000000, masterVolume after a mute boot + normal reload 0; set via ui slider. ?mute=1 is persisted: a later load without mute=1 in the same profile still has masterVolume 0 (BUG-002)

Max over views must be within budget.

specs.title: lowfx: average tick time (no rendering) ≤ 4 ms
specs.method: lowfx page, manual mode. `engine.tick(1/60)` is timed with performance.now() (yields between ticks are not counted) over 10 s of aim with ambient classmates and the natural teacher, then a full flight, then 8 s of an ending. Reports avg / p95 / max per phase and the slowest update order slot is not measured (contract-level only). Machine-dependent: also compare with `node -e` CPU speed if it fails.

specs.details: 13 ending scripts captured for manual review
